name: Independence Day
description: Independence Day word search puzzles offer a calm Fourth of July — parade, picnic, fireworks, banner, anthem, blanket, cheer, cooler, flag and gathering words — for adults and seniors. Free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. Everyday English only: no political campaign brands, no party logos. No timer and no account. Seasonal company includes Summer, Father's Day and American History. Prefer large letters? Use large print. New solvers should read how to play, then pick a grid that feels like a picnic rather than a contest.
